index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_customer_org ON core.tb_observer USING btree (fk_customer_org) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_enabled ON core.tb_observer USING btree (enabled) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_entity_type ON core.tb_observer USING btree (entity_type) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_event_type ON core.tb_observer USING btree (event_type) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_created_at ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (created_at DESC)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_customer_org ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (fk_customer_org)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_entity ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (entity_type, entity_id)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_event_id ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (event_id)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_observer ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (fk_observer)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_retry ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (status, next_retry_at) WHERE (((status)::text = 'failed'::text) AND (next_retry_at IS NOT NULL))
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_status ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (status)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_log_trace_id ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (trace_id) WHERE (trace_id IS NOT NULL)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_priority ON core.tb_observer USING btree (priority) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (enabled = true))
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_observer_name_unique ON core.tb_observer USING btree (name, COALESCE(fk_customer_org, ('-1'::integer)::bigint)) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tb_observer_id_key ON core.tb_observer USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tb_observer_log_id_key ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tb_observer_log_pkey ON core.tb_observer_log USING btree (pk_observer_log)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tb_observer_pkey ON core.tb_observer USING btree (pk_observer)
row level security core.tb_observer off

trigger CREATE TRIGGER tr_observer_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON core.tb_observer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core.fn_update_timestamp()
